description: I8 operations rules, evaluated together with alerts.json (infra/observe/rules.py merges them; the evaluator is python -m infrx.observe.alerts). The metrics come from I8's deployed exporters - infra/observe/durable.py (PostgreSQL truth), host-probe.sh (host truth), canary.sh (the public synthetic check) - or are pending the runtime wiring named in pending_producers. Same rule shape and threshold conventions as alerts.json.

GpuUnavailable.reason: the gateway container has no nvidia-smi, so its infrx_gpu_up is always 0 and would page every cycle; the host probe's reading is the GPU's (WR-I8-4: the gateway stops collecting GPU gauges)

pending_producers.infrx_retention_pending_delete_seconds: WR-I8-M6-1 (M6 phase 2 reports it in RetentionCollector's Report / ProcessingCache but records no metric; FAMILIES declares none)

rules.name: DurableExporterDown
rules.summary: The durable-truth exporter could not read PostgreSQL: queue, hold and drift alerts are blind.
rules.threshold_status: exact: the gauge is 1 or 0

rules.name: ReadyBacklogOld
rules.summary: A dispatch the store made available has waited longer than an async job's queue budget, by durable truth (not the rebuildable index).
rules.threshold_status: derived: QUEUE_WAIT_ASYNC_S = 600 (contracts limits); ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-18): against the measured envelope

rules.name: PreparingStuck
rules.summary: The oldest job still preparing was admitted more than 10 minutes ago.
rules.threshold_status: ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-18): twice the 300 s preparation phase budget

rules.name: QueuedStuck
rules.summary: The oldest queued job has waited longer than an async job's queue budget.
rules.threshold_status: derived: QUEUE_WAIT_ASYNC_S = 600; ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-18): against the measured envelope

rules.name: RunningStuck
rules.summary: A job has been running longer than one generation plus a lease: the engine or the worker is stuck.
rules.threshold_status: derived: GENERATION_TIMEOUT_S 300 + LEASE_TTL_S 120; ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-18): against the measured envelope

rules.name: OverdueJobs
rules.summary: Non-terminal jobs are past their deadline by more than a minute: the reaper is not terminalizing them, and their holds stay reserved.
rules.threshold_status: exact: a job past its deadline must be terminal

rules.name: PlatformFailuresRecent
rules.summary: More than 3 jobs settled with a platform-caused failure in the last 15 minutes (durable truth).
rules.threshold_status: ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-18): engineering guess for a single-GPU pilot

rules.name: StuckHolds
rules.summary: A hold is still reserved for a job that is terminal or long past its deadline.
rules.threshold_status: exact: a terminal job holds nothing

rules.name: UnknownUsageOverdue
rules.summary: An unknown-usage hold is past its reconcile_after and was not released.
rules.threshold_status: exact: reconcile_after is the release deadline

rules.name: OutboxGcLag
rules.summary: Acknowledged outbox rows are kept more than a day past their 7-day retention: the GC is not running.
rules.threshold_status: ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-18): a day of slack over jobstore.OUTBOX_RETENTION_S

rules.name: StreamChunkGcLag
rules.summary: Journal chunks are kept more than an hour past their expiry.
rules.threshold_status: ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-18): an hour of slack over JOURNAL_CHUNK_TTL_S

rules.name: ResultContentPastExpiry
rules.summary: Result bodies are kept more than an hour past their persisted expiry (RV-03/RV-11: fires until D10/M6 content cleanup ships).
rules.threshold_status: ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-18): an hour of slack over RESULT_TTL_S

rules.name: EngineDown
rules.summary: The engine's loopback /health does not answer (host view).
rules.threshold_status: exact: the gauge is 1 or 0

rules.name: UnitInactive
rules.summary: A runtime unit is not active.
rules.threshold_status: exact: the gauge is 1 or 0

rules.name: EdgeInMaintenance
rules.summary: The edge serves the maintenance site: admission is refused (a drain, a rollout or a rollback in progress).
rules.threshold_status: exact: the gauge is 1 or 0

rules.name: PublicEdgeDown
rules.summary: The public /health does not answer 200 from the box (DNS, TLS, the edge, or a 503 after local readiness).
rules.threshold_status: exact: the gauge is 1 or 0

rules.name: ProcessingCacheLarge
rules.summary: The processing cache is above its 60 GiB budget on the instance-store NVMe.
rules.threshold_status: derived: the 60 GiB media budget of infra/README.md §2 (est.); ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-18): against measured cache growth

rules.name: CanaryFailed
rules.summary: The synthetic text or in-cap video request through the public edge did not succeed.
rules.threshold_status: exact: the gauge is 1 or 0

rules.name: CanaryStale
rules.summary: The synthetic inference check has not run for 30 minutes.
rules.threshold_status: derived: three missed 10-minute timer runs

rules.name: CanaryNotConfigured
rules.summary: The synthetic inference check has no canary key: nothing proves the public path serves.
rules.threshold_status: exact: the gauge is 1 or 0

rules.name: DbPoolWaiting
rules.summary: Requests are waiting for a database connection in a runtime pool.
rules.threshold_status: exact: the budget (pool_budget.py) sizes the pools for no wait

rules.name: DbPoolTimeouts
rules.summary: A runtime pool gave up waiting for a connection since the last evaluation.
rules.threshold_status: exact: each is a failed operation

rules.name: DbPoolConnectionErrors
rules.summary: A runtime pool failed to open a connection since the last evaluation (EMAXCONNSESSION, auth, network).
rules.threshold_status: exact: a refused connection is a budget or credential event

rules.name: GatewayBodySlotsFull
rules.summary: Every large-body intake slot of the gateway is in use: further large bodies are refused (buffering bound reached).
rules.threshold_status: exact: at the configured LARGE_BODY_LIMIT

rules.name: RetentionPendingDeleteOld
rules.summary: A retention pass took over a delete left unfinished for longer than a claim plus two passes: tombstoned content is outliving its claims.
rules.threshold_status: derived: M6's rule, claim TTL (lifecycle.CLAIM_TTL_S = 300 s) + 2 x the retention interval (300 s assumed; M6 wiring 1 leaves <RETENTION_INTERVAL_S> open); ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-25): the approved interval

rules.name: RetentionAborting
rules.summary: Three retention passes in a row stopped early (PostgreSQL or the object store unavailable): expired content is not being deleted.
rules.threshold_status: exact: M6 phase 2's rule (3 consecutive aborted passes)

rules.name: RetentionStale
rules.summary: No retention pass has completed for longer than a claim plus three passes: the collector is not running or never finishes.
rules.threshold_status: derived: claim TTL 300 s + 3 x the retention interval (300 s assumed); ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-25): the approved interval

rules.name: RetentionDeleteFailures
rules.summary: An object-store delete failed since the last evaluation: that content stays tombstoned in the bucket until a later claim deletes it.
rules.threshold_status: derived: a failed delete aborts its pass, so at most about one per evaluation; ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-25): whether one failure is worth a ticket

rules.name: ProcessingCacheRefusing
rules.summary: The processing cache refused a put since the last evaluation: above its high water and full of media in use (a retryable 503 to the caller).
rules.threshold_status: derived: every refusal is a caller's retry; ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED (P-25): the high water (PROCESSING_CACHE_MAX_BYTES) itself
